# IMPERIA CW — Cold War: UAE 1970 starting industry — scripted effects.
# COLDWAR | UAE 1970 industrial baseline. Generated by tools/uae_1970/economy_start.py.
COLDWAR_UAE_startup_industry = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			original_tag = UAE
			is_dynamic_country = no
			IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes
			COLDWAR_UAE_1970_campaign = yes
			date < 1970.1.3
			NOT = { has_country_flag = IMP_1970_gdp_profile_applied }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_industry_start_applied }
			owns_state = 179
			controls_state = 179
			owns_state = 180
			controls_state = 180
		}
		179 = {
			add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = -19 }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_start_composite_removals = 0 }
			while_loop_effect = {
			 limit = {
			  composite_plant > 0
			  check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_start_composite_removals value = 5 compare = less_than }
			 }
			 remove_building = { type = composite_plant level = 1 }
			 add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_start_composite_removals = 1 }
			}
		}
		180 = {
			add_resource = { type = aluminium amount = -22 }
			add_resource = { type = steel amount = -5 }
			set_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_start_composite_removals = 0 }
			while_loop_effect = {
			 limit = {
			  composite_plant > 0
			  check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_UAE_start_composite_removals value = 5 compare = less_than }
			 }
			 remove_building = { type = composite_plant level = 1 }
			 add_to_temp_variable = { COLDWAR_UAE_start_composite_removals = 1 }
			}
		}
		set_country_flag = COLDWAR_UAE_industry_start_applied
	}
}
